$schema_description: Generic Slack OAuth config for yaas. Defines the scopes and PKCE flow. Per-install values (app_id, client_id, workspace) live in .env at the repo root — see .env.example. Used by setup.sh.

slack_app.description: Personal Slack assistant. Watches the threads you choose and drafts replies as you.

_reactions_read_note: reactions:read may require workspace admin approval in some orgs. If approval is required, request it before running setup.sh; or proceed without — the reaction-monitoring path in the orchestrator will return zero results until the scope is granted, then each user re-runs setup.sh to re-authorize.
_reactions_write_note: reactions:write is REQUIRED, not optional: the reaction lifecycle in surfaces/react-lifecycle.py calls reactions.add / reactions.remove (via client.py) to swap the loading and done emoji on a message. Without it every lifecycle transition fails with missing_scope and the user sees their trigger emoji never change.
